model_annotation: The bar chart displays the overall performance in percentage for ten large language models evaluated on knowledge-grounded discussion summarization under the ABS-AOS pattern, with each bar representing a distinct model’s performance score labeled numerically above it; the vertical y-axis is labeled “Overall Performance (%)” and spans from 0 to 60 in increments of 20, while the horizontal x-axis lists the models implicitly through their performance values without explicit model names; the bars are color-coded in varying shades of green, purple, blue, beige, and gray, with the highest-performing model achieving 61.09% and the lowest 24.64%, and the performance is stratified into three tiers as indicated in the caption: Tier-1 includes models scoring between 55% and 61% (61.09%, 60.72%, 54.83%), Tier-2 includes those between 41% and 49% (48.28%, 48.83%, 43.79%, 46.36%, 44.09%, 40.87%), and Tier-3 includes the model scoring 27.22%, with the bar for 24.64% falling below Tier-3; the bars are arranged in no obvious sorted order, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, borders, or annotations beyond their numerical labels.

model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the overall performance (in percentage) of various large language models (LLMs) on a knowledge-grounded discussion summarization benchmark under the ABS-AOS pattern, with performance values explicitly labeled atop each bar. The vertical axis, labeled “Overall Performance (%)”, ranges from 0 to 60 in increments of 20, while the horizontal axis lists individual LLMs (though their names are not visible in the image). The bars are color-coded and vary in height, reflecting performance scores that span from 24.64% to 61.09%. According to the caption, these models are stratified into three tiers based on their geometric mean overall performance (OP_GM): Tier-1 includes models with scores between 55% and 61% (e.g., 61.09%, 60.72%, 54.83%), Tier-2 includes those between 41% and 49% (e.g., 48.28%, 48.83%, 43.79%, 46.36%, 44.09%, 40.87%, 43.54%), and Tier-3 includes the lowest-performing model at 27.22% (with 24.64% also falling below Tier-3 range). The chart visually emphasizes performance disparities across models, with the top-performing model exceeding 61% and the lowest dipping below 25%, suggesting significant variation in capability for this specific summarization task.
